cases.description: The Chair and a member join the online room of a running Online meeting and see each other.
procedure: As Member A (Chủ toạ) open the meeting room; read the lobby "Sẵn sàng tham gia?" and click "Vào phòng".
As Member C in a second browser open the room and click "Vào phòng".
expected: The lobby shows the recording notice "Cuộc họp được ghi âm để lập biên bản …".
Both are in the room; the header says 2 people; "Người dự" lists Hoàng Minh Đức (Chủ toạ) and Đặng Quốc Bảo.
preconditions: An Online meeting "[SYS] Họp trực tuyến WF-05" in progress with Chủ toạ Member A, Thư ký Member B, Members C and E and a guest; the media server is running; camera and microphone allowed.
cases.aiNote: BF-03 · UC-37 · 5.2: ROOM_FT01, ROOM_FT02, ROOM_FT49 · Evidence: QA run SYS-WF05 20261123-065244-0c98bde8 · Run by the QA runner on a local build of app 6baba24f.

cases.description: The guest opens the link in the invitation email, enters the one-time code, gives a name and joins the room.
procedure: Open the guest link from the invitation email in a fresh browser.
Enter the 6-digit code from the second email and click "Xác minh".
Type "Nguyễn Khách Mời" in "Tên hiển thị", click "Vào cuộc họp", open the room and click "Vào phòng".
expected: The page shows the meeting title and "Nhập mã 6 số đã gửi tới …" with the masked email.
After the code and name the guest sees only this meeting; in the room the Chair's "Người dự" lists "Nguyễn Khách Mời" without an email.
preconditions: TC01 passed; the invitation and the code reach a mailbox the tester can read.
cases.aiNote: BF-03 · UC-04, UC-37 · BR-150, BR-152 · 5.2: ROOM_FT17, ROOM_FT51 · Run by hand by Nguyễn Trường Huy on the app server (app.trustcabinet.workspace-hub.space, app 6baba24f), the only environment with the speech worker, the local language model, Google Sign-In and real mail.

cases.description: A member raises a hand, the Chair invites them, and they start speaking.
procedure: As Member E in the room click "Giơ tay".
As Member A click "Phát biểu", then "Mời" on Member E's row.
As Member E click "Bật micro" in the banner "Đến lượt bạn phát biểu", then "Bắt đầu phát biểu".
expected: Member E's button becomes "Hạ tay"; the Chair's "Phát biểu" shows 1 and the queue lists Ngô Thanh Sơn.
Member E sees "Đến lượt bạn phát biểu" with "Bật micro" and "Bắt đầu phát biểu"; raising a hand did not turn the microphone on.
After starting, the microphone is on and the request is "Speaking".
preconditions: TC01 passed; no open speaking request.

cases.description: What a person says with the microphone on is recorded per microphone and reaches tab "Bản ghi".
procedure: As Member C join the room with the microphone on and speak for about 20 seconds.
Leave the room and open tab "Bản ghi" as the Secretary.
expected: The sentences Member C said are stored under their name and listed in "Bản ghi".
preconditions: TC01 passed; a person speaking into a real microphone.

cases.description: A member leaves and comes back; when the Chair ends the meeting the room closes for those inside.
procedure: As Member C in the room click "Rời phòng", read the dialog and confirm "Rời phòng"; then open the room again and join.
As Member A on the meeting page click "Kết thúc họp" and confirm.
expected: The dialog says "Cuộc họp vẫn tiếp tục với những người khác. Bạn có thể vào lại khi cuộc họp còn đang diễn ra."; Member C can join again.
Member C's room shows "Cuộc họp đã kết thúc, phòng họp đã đóng." with no "Vào lại"; the meeting is Ended.
